summary: Maison Solutions Inc., through its majority-owned subsidiaries GF San Gabriel (91%) and GF Monrovia (85.25%), entered an Asset Purchase Agreement to sell store machinery, equipment, fixtures, and beer/wine licenses of two Asian grocery stores in San Gabriel and Monrovia, CA, for $4,500,000 ($2,250,000 per store). Inventory sold separately. Purchase price payable lump-sum by Dec 31, 2026 if buyer financing funds, otherwise via two secured promissory notes at 10% p.a. with quarterly installments ending Sep 30, 2027, default rate 18% p.a. Guaranteed by Qinghui Ni and ENSON GROUP, INC. Closing subject to California ABC approval; no advisor named. Watch for financing contingency and regulatory license transfer timeline.
